rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with the provided 3AA grade, but it overstates image-specific detail such as exact ICM position, visible cell borders, estimated TE cell count, metabolic interpretation of blastocoel contents, and focal plane quality that may not be reliably inferable from a single embryo image.
Strong integration of age, ovarian reserve, BMI, tubal factor diagnosis, sperm parameters, endometrial thickness, and first-cycle status with embryo quality and prognosis.

Overall logical and well-structured, with prognosis flowing from embryo quality and patient factors, though some quantitative claims and additive probability adjustments are more assertive than clearly supported.

Core recommendations such as single embryo transfer are guideline-concordant, but several elements are weakly supported or nonstandard, including ERA after a single failure, routine aspirin suggestion, morning transfer preference, MBSR effect size claim, and some overly specific medication targets.

Provides clear practical recommendations for transfer strategy, luteal support, lifestyle advice, and contingency planning, though some suggestions are overly prescriptive or not universally indicated.
